head: 62e5837298e6a049b9920aaf3b64d691aabf8841
summary: Every major/minor finding the three review reports (spec, standards, adversarial) raised is fixed on the current head (62e58372), independently re-verified by reading the code and by re-running the full gate chain myself, not by trusting the fix report's narration. L03-SPEC-01 (#1069, major): confirmed apps/web/components/work/accounting-work-list.tsx's workRowClaimLabel (lines 163-172) reads row.allocation_count and renders WorkList.claimLabelWithCount on the Work LIST row itself, and apps/web/lib/work/work-list.ts's WorkListRow carries allocation_count; packages/db/migrations/0341_work_claim_allocation_count.sql recuts clara.list_accounting_work and clara.get_accounting_work_row (not only the detail door) at their true pre-images; db test wl.33 and web cells (accounting-work-list.test.tsx) pass. L03-SPEC-02/ADV-01 (#1068, major, disabled focus target): confirmed staff-advance-allocations-editor.tsx's Add button disabled expression is now `(candidates.length === 0 && !addressesEmptyState) || Boolean(emptyStateProps.disabled)`, and that `disabled` inside emptyStateProps only ever reflects controlProps' `disabled: busy` (form-submission state), never candidate emptiness; the hardened cell (staff-expense-claim-form.test.tsx, 'ticket 1068 fix round') now asserts both `disabled === null` AND membership in focusableElements(h.container), closing the harness-stub gap the reviewer found. ADV-02 (#1068, major, mislabelled button): confirmed emptyStateProps spreads `aria-label: t('addAllocation')`, outranking the inherited `<Label htmlFor>`; both claim-form and editor test files assert the name is present when addressed. ADV-03 (#1052, major, chooser/wall divergence): confirmed advanceCandidates in staff-expense-claim-form.tsx now checks `!a.enrolment_active` before EITHER arm (same-account or label-matched second account), matching the door's `sa2.active` requirement on both; the retired-generation cell (line ~1016) now asserts refusal/non-offering, and the positive-attribution cell was moved onto a candidate the door admits. L03-SPEC-03 (#1066, major, silent override): confirmed the claim form renders `data-testid="advance-account-follows-head"` (StaffExpenseClaim.advanceAccountCodeFollowsHead) driven by the same claimAdvanceAccountCode reader the wire uses, null when the head matches the typed account, naming the real account otherwise; the mounted cell 'ticket 1066 fix round the claim says WHICH account it will credit...' asserts both branches. L03-SPEC-04 (#1066, minor, never driven through a real door): confirmed packages/db/tests/staff-expense-claim-allocations.test.mjs's new p1066.head cell posts the exact toClaimWire cross-account-HEAD shape (bare head row, advance_account_code following the head, non-head row stating its own account_code) and asserts both credit legs, both allocation-to-leg keys, both outstanding balances and the stored advance_account_code — it is part of the 79-test packages/db run I re-ran myself. ADV-04/ADV-05 (#1066, minor): confirmed claimAdvanceAccountCode is the single reader used by validateClaimDraft (line 482), derivedLines (568) and toClaimWire (678); confirmed derivedLines only emits the per-account split when `allocated === claimTotalCents(draft)`, otherwise falling back to the single balanced leg on the head account — both dedicated cells (head.account, preview.balance) exist in staff-expense-claim.test.ts and pass. L03-SPEC-05 (#1066, minor, stays with reason): the fix report's argued refusal to add a chooser-side signal (the predicate cannot distinguish a spelling variant from a different person, and #1049/staff-master is the real fix, correctly re-parented to the mainline) is a reasoned residue, not a code defect; no regression. ADV-06/ADV-07 (#1067, notes): both recorded, verbatim, in packages/db/README.md's 0339 section (grepped 'structurally unreachable' and 'statement_timeout ... the lane's decision, recorded'). L03-SPEC-06/07/08/09 (notes): no action was required by the original reviews; re-read and still true (L03-SPEC-09's ask for a pinning cell is answered by preview.balance, confirmed above). Standards minor (#1069 ticket report omits the rule-(d) gate line): the exact named file (reports/waveS-lane03-ticket1069.md) was NOT edited — grepped for 'firm-scope-db-pins'/'pins corpus' there and got zero hits — but the standards reviewer's own required_fix offered an explicit alternative ('or confirm it was run and simply not recorded'), and the fix report supplies exactly that confirmation plus the result (22/22), with a stated write-scope reason for not touching a per-ticket report from a different round. Left as a residue for the integrator to fold in, not a live defect; independently re-run again by me (22/22, apps/web/tests/firm-scope-db-pins.test.ts, as part of the 176-test web-file batch below). Nothing above minor remains, so the round is accepted.
